scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.fix: ultracite fix src vite.config.ts && uvx ruff check --fix backend && uvx ruff format backend
scripts.lint: ultracite check src vite.config.ts && uvx ruff check backend && uvx ruff format --check backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && uv run --with-requirements requirements.txt --with pyright pyright backend
